The pair-game equivalence is proved by induction with arbitrary Bob words, and full synchronization by repeated pair merges or a perpetual rotating witness. An independent finite powerset-attractor algorithm agrees on all transition maps through six states, with a three-stage example at eight states. Infinite conclusions rest on the proof, not the finite checker.
